notes: The original manifest contains every fixed raw URL, source commit, SHA-256 digest, byte count, and representation note.
Mutable PR bodies are explicitly labeled as snapshots in the original manifest.
The evidence dataset records GitHub PR URLs, merge commits, public commit sequences, classifications, CI observations, candidate queries, and representative exclusions.
Heads are default-branch HEADs reverified on 2026-09-12. A sampled merged PR can target a non-default or stacked branch and therefore be newer than the default HEAD commit.
The raw API manifest indexes unmodified GitHub REST responses for the three core cases: obra/superpowers#2275, OpenHands/OpenHands#17253, and obra/superpowers#1720.
